explanation.summary: STEINKJER CAMPING AS (941 782 493), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1986-12-05; address Elvenget 34, 7716 STEINKJER, Norge. Main industry is 68.200 Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom; 8 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Monica Klungerbo Vandbakk; Board chair: Sindre Vandbakk. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 3.67 m, operating profit NOK 1.74 m, net profit NOK 1.44 m, equity NOK 2.28 m, total assets NOK 3.62 m. Website https://www.steinkjercamping.no shows the registered name.
